slides.texte_overlay:
things that lower stress
+ why they help

1. a walk without your phone

why: no notifications, just movement and fresh air.
your mind finally gets a break.

2. writing your thoughts down

why: once it's on paper,
you stop repeating it in your head.

3. tidying one small corner

why: a finished task, even a tiny one,
feels like control again.

4. calling someone you love

why: saying it out loud makes it smaller.

5. learning something new

why: it gives your mind something calm to hold onto.
before, i scrolled when i was stressed. now i learn one thing about the world. and i actually feel better.
